pages.title: Gary the Snail Crawling Along a Slime Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail crawls along a winding slime trail in this printable coloring page, with raised eyestalks and an oval-spotted shell above scattered pebbles. The coloring sheet has broad open spaces across his body and shell, while the spiral, small rocks, and meandering trail add a few smaller sections.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Eating From His Food Bowl Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gary the Snail eating from his food bowl, with lowered eyes beside a round porthole and a bamboo-patterned wall. His large spiral shell dominates the coloring sheet, balancing wide areas against the bowl's small food pieces, door fittings, and narrow vertical wall sections.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Sleeping in His Pet Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail sleeps in his pet bed in this printable coloring page, with closed eyes and his spotted spiral shell above a cushioned rim. The uncluttered coloring sheet focuses on the resting snail, leaving generous open areas inside the shell and bedding, with curved folds providing smaller details around the cushion.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Reading a Newspaper Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Gary the Snail reading a newspaper outside SpongeBob's pineapple house, with his eyes peeking over the open pages near the door. The coloring sheet combines large blank newspaper panels and a spiral shell with smaller details in the porthole, patterned house wall, and pebbled ground.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Wearing His Royal Crown Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail wears his royal crown in this printable coloring page, perched on a tasseled cushion with oval shell spots and tall, raised eyestalks. The coloring sheet includes rounded crown ornaments, a braided cushion edge, and hanging tassels, adding narrow details around the broad white spaces of Gary's shell and body.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Playing with His Red Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gary the Snail playing with his red ball, nudging its curved striped surface across pebbled ground beside tufts of seaweed. His smiling face and spotted spiral shell fill most of the coloring sheet, while movement marks around the ball suggest its roll and create a few smaller details.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Wearing His Talking Translation Collar Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail wears his talking translation collar in this printable coloring page, with a round speaker grille beneath his eyestalks and coral in the background. Wide shell and body areas dominate the coloring sheet, with smaller circles in the speaker, oval shell markings, and scattered pebbles adding detail around the central figure.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Wrapped in Christmas Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Gary the Snail wrapped in Christmas lights, with oversized bulbs circling his shell beside a candy cane and SpongeBob's pineapple house. The coloring sheet pairs the shell's large spiral and oval spots with narrow wires, bulb fittings, candy-cane stripes, and the house's crisscross pattern.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Wearing a Jack-o-lantern Shell for Halloween Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail wears a jack-o-lantern shell for Halloween in this printable coloring page, with triangular cutouts, a toothy grin, and a smaller pumpkin nearby. Broad pumpkin segments cover most of the coloring sheet, while Gary's long eyestalks, the curved stem, and small ground pebbles provide contrasting shapes around the costume.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Riding on SpongeBob's Head Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gary the Snail riding on SpongeBob's head, with both characters smiling and Gary's spotted spiral shell above SpongeBob's large eyes. The full-length coloring sheet includes SpongeBob's tie, belt, striped socks, and rounded shoes, offering smaller clothing details beneath the broad open spaces of his face and Gary's shell.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Showing Off His Fancy Pet Show Makeover Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail shows off his fancy pet show makeover in this printable coloring page, wearing a large bow and frilled shell trim on a podium. A rosette decorates the front of the platform, while ribbon tails and gathered frills add smaller sections to the coloring sheet around Gary's familiar shell spiral and oval markings.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Watching Television with SpongeBob Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gary the Snail watching television with SpongeBob, who sits in an armchair beside a framed flower picture and bamboo-patterned walls. Gary rests on an oval rug in the foreground, and the coloring sheet balances his large shell with the chair cushions, television frame, and SpongeBob's small clothing details.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Waking SpongeBob for Breakfast Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail wakes SpongeBob for breakfast in this printable coloring page, calling beside an empty food bowl while SpongeBob sits up beneath a flower-patterned blanket. The coloring sheet includes a round porthole, bamboo-style bedposts, and a curved headboard, with broad bedding sections surrounding the two characters and smaller shell spots below.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Exploring His Outdoor Playhouse with SpongeBob Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Gary the Snail exploring his outdoor playhouse with SpongeBob, who rests a hand on its scalloped roof near the pineapple house. Gary peers from the arched entrance, and round windows, vertical wall panels, and a spiral roof ornament add distinct shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Gary the Snail on a Nighttime Adventure with Spot Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail sets out on a nighttime adventure with Spot in this printable coloring page, beneath a crescent moon near SpongeBob's distant pineapple house. Spot's round body, open mouth, and raised tail contrast with Gary's tall eyestalks, while the coloring sheet includes a winding pebble path and scattered flower-shaped sky motifs.

pages.title: Gary the Snail with SpongeBob and Patrick Outside the Pineapple House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gary the Snail with SpongeBob and Patrick outside the pineapple house, with Gary's large spiral shell centered in the foreground. The bordered coloring sheet includes SpongeBob's tie, Patrick's patterned shorts, and the house's round door fittings, balancing small outlined details with broad areas across all three characters.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Meeting Mary at the Snail Park Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail meets Mary at the snail park in this printable coloring page, facing her spotted bow and long eyelashes beside an empty wooden sign. The two spiral shells create large coloring areas, while the coloring sheet adds smaller bow dots, ground pebbles, sign fasteners, and thin seaweed blades behind the pair.

pages.title: Gary the Snail and Snellie Nuzzling Beside the Racetrack Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Gary the Snail and Snellie nuzzling beside the racetrack, with their faces touching beneath Snellie's large bow and curved eyelashes. Broad spiral shells occupy the middle of the coloring sheet, while curved track lanes sweep across the foreground and small pebbles dot the open space around them.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Racing Against Snellie and Patrick's Pet Rock Rocky Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail races against Snellie and Patrick's pet rock Rocky in this printable coloring page, with all three spread across marked lanes near the pineapple house. Short motion lines emphasize the race, and the coloring sheet includes Snellie's bow, Gary's spotted shell, Rocky's small surface marks, and the house's crisscross wall pattern.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Attracting Coins Beside Mr. Krabs Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gary the Snail attracting coins beside Mr. Krabs, who raises both claws while several coins move toward Gary's spotted shell. The uncluttered coloring sheet emphasizes their contrasting shapes, with coin rims, a rectangular belt buckle, and scattered ground pebbles adding small details around the two large figures.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Eating Gramma's Stack of Pancakes Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail eats Gramma's stack of pancakes in this printable coloring page, leaning toward syrup-covered layers topped with a pat of butter on a plate. The coloring sheet includes Gary's large spiral shell, a bamboo-patterned wall, and a round flower picture, contrasting the pancakes' narrow layers with broad open body and shell sections.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Beside King Poseidon's Throne in the Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Gary the Snail beside King Poseidon's throne in the palace, below the crowned king's trident and the throne's large shell-shaped back. Gary fills the foreground, while draped curtains, columns, wide steps, and the king's folded robe add varied spaces and finer contours throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Reciting Poetry at the Krusty Krab Talent Show Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail recites poetry at the Krusty Krab talent show in this printable coloring page, standing on a stool beside a microphone between drawn curtains. His open mouth and raised eyestalks face the microphone, whose crosshatched grille adds fine detail to the coloring sheet alongside the stool legs and stage floorboards.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Playing Squidward's Clarinet at Home Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gary the Snail playing Squidward's clarinet at home, with the instrument's flared bell resting on a small stool beside an armchair. Round clarinet keys and narrow wall panels add detail to the coloring sheet, while a framed flower and potted coral sit behind Gary's broad spiral shell.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Driving a Boatmobile Through Bikini Bottom Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail drives a boatmobile through Bikini Bottom in this printable coloring page, seated behind a round steering wheel near SpongeBob's distant pineapple house. The coloring sheet features a curved windshield, small bow flag, rear propeller, and rounded wheels, with broad striped hull panels beneath Gary's familiar spotted shell.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Vacationing at Club Shell in His Inflatable Shell Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gary the Snail vacationing at Club Shell in his inflatable shell, beside a swimming pool with a lounge chair and umbrella. Rounded shell segments and a small air valve distinguish his outfit, while the coloring sheet adds pool ripples, narrow edge tiles, and larger open deck sections.

pages.title: Gary the Snail and SpongeBob Leading Jellyfish Back to Jellyfish Fields Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail and SpongeBob lead jellyfish back to Jellyfish Fields in this printable coloring page, walking beneath three smiling jellyfish among bubbles and seaweed. The coloring sheet combines Gary's broad spiral shell and SpongeBob's open face with narrow tentacles, small jellyfish spots, and scattered pebbles along the seabed.

pages.title: Baby Gary the Snail Meeting Young SpongeBob at Kamp Koral Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features baby Gary the Snail meeting young SpongeBob at Kamp Koral, where SpongeBob crouches beside him wearing a cap and neckerchief. A cabin porch and winding path frame the pair, and the coloring sheet includes the cap's tree emblem, striped socks, small shell spots, and simple coral shapes.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Taking a Photograph with a Camera From His Shell Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary the Snail takes a photograph with a camera from his shell in this printable coloring page, with its jointed support raised above his spotted spiral. The camera's large circular lens and small controls add detailed sections to the coloring sheet, while bubbles, coral, and pebbles surround the broad outlines of Gary's body.

pages.title: Gary the Snail Watching SpongeBob Mop Up His Slime Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Gary the Snail watching SpongeBob mop up his slime trail, with a long winding puddle across the floor between the characters. Gary's spotted shell fills the foreground, and the coloring sheet includes individual mop strands, floorboards, a porthole door, and potted coral on a small side table.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Pointing at Kelp Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob points toward a tall kelp forest in this printable coloring page, smiling with one hand resting on Gary's spotted spiral shell beside the sandy path. Long leafy stems, small rocks, coral, and rising bubbles surround the pair, adding narrow plant shapes around their broad character outlines.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Sitting at Chum Bucket Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary sit together at the Chum Bucket in this printable coloring page, smiling across a round table set with a bowl and two cups. Wooden stools, floorboards, a counter, and the large restaurant sign fill the setting, with Gary's spiral shell beside the tabletop.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Jumping at Kelp Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary jump through a kelp forest in this printable coloring page, grinning as SpongeBob spreads both arms and Gary rises beside the long waving leaves. Curved movement marks and bubbles accent their leap, with small rocks and shorter plants growing across the sandy seafloor below.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Standing at Super Weenie Hut Jr Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary stand outside Super Weenie Hut Jr. in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath a huge sign decorated with stars and small triangular banners. The building's striped awning, windows, flags, and brick details surround the pair, offering smaller sections beside SpongeBob's square pants and Gary's spiral shell.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Waving at Goo Lagoon Pier Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary wave on the Goo Lagoon pier in this printable coloring page, smiling beside the wooden railings above gently outlined water and a curving beach. Palm trees rise on the far bank beneath a cheerful sun, while the pier's planks and round posts add repeated shapes.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Running Inside Giant Clam Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary hurry through a giant clam cave in this printable coloring page, with SpongeBob running arms raised while Gary follows beside him with a smile. The shell's ridged outer curve frames rough tunnel walls, hanging points, scattered stones, and a dark opening deeper inside the cave.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Posing in Jellyfish Fields Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary pose in Jellyfish Fields in this printable coloring page, smiling together as SpongeBob lifts both arms beneath a group of floating spotted jellyfish overhead. Rolling slopes, small coral shapes, flowers, and grass tufts add background details around Gary's patterned shell and SpongeBob's broad square body.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Sitting at Bargain Mart Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob sits beside Gary at Bargain Mart in this printable coloring page, smiling from a tall stool while the snail rests on the shop counter beside him. Shelves of bottles, boxes, cans, and packets fill the background beneath the store sign, with a tiled floor below their pose.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Looking Around at Chum Bucket Laboratory Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary look around the Chum Bucket laboratory in this printable coloring page, standing beside a workbench with a microscope, glass flasks, and loose gears nearby. Large machines, pressure dials, pipes, a ladder, and hanging tools fill the detailed room behind their cheerful faces and bold outlines.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Looking Around in Underwater Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Gary rides on SpongeBob's head in this printable coloring page as they look around an underwater garden filled with coral, leafy plants, and rounded rocks nearby. Bubbles and simple flowerlike shapes float above the winding sandy path, framing Gary's spotted spiral shell and SpongeBob's small smile.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Jumping at Treasure Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary jump beside treasure in this printable coloring page, smiling inside a rocky cave as SpongeBob raises both hands beneath his tied pirate bandana. An open chest overflows with coins, jewels, and bead necklaces, with hanging cave points, seaweed, bubbles, and loose stones around the pair.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Looking Around on Boating School Test Track Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob carries Gary on his head around a boating school test track in this printable coloring page, walking toward a striped finish line with a smile. Traffic cones, dashed road markings, low fences, and scattered grass trace the winding course toward a small building in the distance.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Pointing at Krusty Krab Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary point toward the Krusty Krab in this printable coloring page, standing beside the sandy path with SpongeBob wearing a broad cheerful grin above his tie. The restaurant's curved roof, hanging flags, double doors, and tall shell-shaped sign rise behind small seaweed clumps and pebbles.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Standing in Downtown Bikini Bottom Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary stand in downtown Bikini Bottom in this printable coloring page, smiling as SpongeBob raises one open hand beside Gary's tall eyestalks and spiral shell. Tube-shaped buildings, porthole windows, a pineapple house, a streetlamp, and arrow signs line the road, adding small city details around the pair.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Standing Confidently On Road Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob stands confidently beside Gary on a winding road in this printable coloring page, placing both hands at his hips beneath a small calm smile and wide eyes. Large rounded paving stones fill the foreground, with coral shapes, pebbles, and a distant pineapple house beside the curved route.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Reaching In Room Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob reaches toward Gary inside a room in this printable coloring page, extending one open hand while Gary looks upward with his mouth open beside an oval rug. A bed, two-drawer cabinet, tall chair, and round porthole window create simple furniture shapes around the pair's bold outlines.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Thinking In Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob thinks beside Gary in a desert in this printable coloring page, touching his chin beneath a question-mark thought bubble while Gary looks up with an open mouth. Tall cacti of different sizes, small pebbles, and rolling sand lines fill the otherwise open landscape around their standing pose.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Resting In Town Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob appears in two smiling poses in this printable coloring page, resting in a shared hammock while Gary sits on a nearby flat rock beside the palms. Pineapple houses, coral, a streetlamp, and a smoking mountain decorate the town, offering many small details around the relaxed characters.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Pointing By Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob points beside a lake in this printable coloring page, smiling toward Gary as a small boat floats on the gently rippling water beyond the shore behind them. Rounded mountains and two simple clouds form the distant backdrop, leaving broad spaces around Gary's spiral shell and SpongeBob's square pants.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Standing Calmly In Village Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary stand calmly in a village in this printable coloring page, smiling together on open sandy ground surrounded by several pineapple-shaped houses with round windows. Coral branches, chimney bubbles, and scattered ground marks add smaller details around their broad bodies, tall eyestalks, tie, and striped socks.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Waving At Fishing Spot Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob waves at a fishing spot in this printable coloring page, holding a rod from a wooden pier while Gary sits on a small rock beside him. A fish rises near the hanging line, with large boulders, simple clouds, a round sun, and distant houses framing the water.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Observing In Floating Island Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary observe their surroundings on a floating island in this printable coloring page, standing together above its jagged pointed underside and loose little rocks below. Small plants and pebbles dot the platform, with three broad clouds and gently curved water lines around the unusual island setting.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Thinking In Adventure Area Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary think through an adventure in this printable coloring page, with SpongeBob holding a folded map beneath compass and question-mark thought bubbles above his head. Gary wears an explorer hat beside a closed treasure chest, while tropical leaves, rounded mountains, and a winding trail fill the background.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Posing In House Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob poses with his arms spread inside a house in this printable coloring page, smiling beside Gary and a small table near a curved sofa behind them. The open cutaway view reveals the room beneath a rounded roof with porthole windows, a chimney, and a broad projecting awning.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Watching In Park Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob watches the park beside Gary in this printable coloring page, sitting on a wooden bench with a woven picnic basket held across his lap before him. Gary wears a small cap beside the bench, surrounded by rounded trees, bushes, grass, clouds, and a winding path.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Observing In Level Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary observe a miniature level in this printable coloring page, smiling beside a clear-sided display marked with a Level 1 sign above the small snail. Floating blocks, sandy ground, coral, and a treasure chest fill the box, adding simple game-inspired shapes around the characters.

pages.title: SpongeBob Gary Smiling By Water Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob and Gary smile beside water in this printable coloring page, with SpongeBob spreading both arms while Gary opens his mouth below his tall round eyestalks and spotted shell. A few bubbles rise near the ripples, and rounded hills and a simple sun keep the background open.
